structure.unit: Virginia Residential Landlord and Tenant Act

law.catch_line: Sheriffs authorized to serve certain notices; fee for service
law.text: The sheriff of any county or city, upon request, may deliver any notice to a tenant on behalf of a landlord or lessor under the provisions of § 55.1-1245 or 55.1-1415. For this service, the sheriff shall be allowed a fee not to exceed $12.
